column6: States the problem concretely in 1 to 2 minutes: who experiences it and what it costs them, why it was not already solved, the team's specific scope and what was deliberately left out; supported with visuals, not a talking head.
column9: Problem statement is present but partly vague, the cost to the user or the explicit scope is underspecified, or it leans on a talking head instead of visuals.
column12: Problem statement missing, generic, or not connected to what the video shows.

column1: Showcase: end to end, realistic, honest [SO2]
column6: Shows the project in action for 5 to 7 minutes: product and tool teams walk one or two complete use cases end to end from a realistic user entry point; research and pipeline teams run the pipeline or analysis end to end with findings a non-specialist can follow; narration is clear, technically interesting parts are highlighted, partial features are named plainly, and no silence exceeds five seconds.
column9: Showcase shows the project working but skips a complete end-to-end walkthrough, starts from an unrealistic entry point, glosses over partial features, or has unclear narration or long silences.
column12: Showcase absent, slides-only, or does not show the project or pipeline in action.

column1: Metrics evidence: measured, instrumented, matching docs/shipped.md [SO2]
column6: Restates the 2 or 3 success metrics from docs/shipped.md, and reports a real measured value for at least one with instrumentation evidence on screen (analytics screenshot, benchmark output, download or install counts, user task results).
column9: Metrics are restated but do not fully match docs/shipped.md, or a measured value is reported without visible instrumentation evidence.
column12: No real measured value for any metric, or the metrics segment is missing.

column1: Honest outcomes: delivered versus the Definition of Shipped [SO6]
column6: Assesses outcomes with concrete numbers against the category's bar: delivered versus the Definition of Shipped; what is fully working, partial, or descoped; patches accepted, users reached, deployment status, or findings produced; closes with the one or two most important lessons and the highest-priority next step. Honest shortfalls with clear accounts score well.
column9: Outcomes are summarized but the comparison to the Definition of Shipped is superficial, numbers are missing where they exist, or lessons and the next step are vague.
column12: Outcomes segment missing, or claims only success with no honest assessment against the Definition of Shipped.

column6: One-page release notes include project name, team, date, the video link with per-segment timestamps, a one-paragraph summary, features or findings delivered, one line of measured outcome, known limitations, and the repository or archive link; all links work in a private browser window; the video is 8 to 12 minutes, on media.oregonstate.edu as unlisted, with clear narration and captions or a transcript.
column9: Release notes are present but missing some elements (e.g., timestamps, measured outcome line, or limitations), or the video has minor length, hosting, caption, or audio issues.
column12: Release notes missing or too sparse to use, links graders cannot open, or the video is significantly outside 8 to 12 minutes or missing captions and transcript.
